# @agents-js/shell-args

> Quote-safe shell-style argument tokenizer (shlex-like). Splits a command/flags string into argv tokens honoring single/double quotes and backslash escapes, leniently (never throws).

## Installation

```sh
bun add @agents-js/shell-args
```
